name: Off Localhost
tagline: Your repo works. Get it off localhost.
voice: A developer tool that takes a finished repo the last mile. Plain, terse, honest about limits. Never hype, never exclamation marks, never em dashes, never claim Hacker News or Product Hunt automation (both are assisted: the post is staged, the human presses submit). Green #0b7a4b means live, done, or a passing gate, and nothing else. Orange #c2410c means a hoop the human still has to jump through, never decoration. No purple, no gradients, no emoji section markers. Paper-white ground, near-black ink, mono type for commands. Wordmark is lowercase 'off localhost' behind a green prompt caret.
